_comment: git.deploymentEnabled.gh-pages=false: best-effort guard. The gh-pages branch is a pure static site with no FastAPI entrypoint, so Vercel's FastAPI preset fails it with 'No FastAPI entrypoint found'. THE authoritative fix is the Vercel dashboard: project -> Settings -> Git -> Production Branch = master (the read-only API lives on master at api/index.py). This guard only applies to automatic deployments of branches whose deployed config includes it, so it may not stop a production-branch gh-pages build on its own.
